ch03f-combining-and-change#9:
cents = int(input("Cents: "))
print(f"${cents / 100:.2f}")
quarters = cents // 25
cents -= quarters * 25
dimes = cents // 10
cents -= dimes * 10
nickels = cents // 5
cents -= nickels * 5
print("Quarters", quarters)
print("Dimes", dimes)
print("Nickels", nickels)
print("Pennies", cents)
print("Coins", quarters + dimes + nickels + cents)

ch05f-until-a-stop-value#9:
total = 0
how_many = 0
while True:
    number = int(input("Number (0 to stop): "))
    if number == 0:
        break
    total = total + number
    how_many = how_many + 1
print("Total:", total)
print("Count:", how_many)
